summary: Phase H Batch 4 verified — Electrical 4 + Confined Space 1 + Environmental 3 + Wellness 6 = 14 topics uplifted with EN+ES incident_pattern + EN-only severity. Library integrity via Node import: 134 EN === 134 ES, 115 with incident_pattern in BOTH languages, 53 EN with severity, 0 ES-missing-pattern-when-EN-has-it. UI verified at /meetings/new in EN: LOTO/fatigue/lightning/confined_space all inject 'WHAT HAPPENS · real-world pattern' header + EN body into discussion_notes. ES picker confirmed showing Spanish chip labels (Todos 134, Tubería 3, Excavación 4, Movimiento 5, ...) and Spanish topic titles (Seguridad Eléctrica, Bloqueo/Etiquetado, Generador/Energía Temporal, Operaciones de Torre de Iluminación). All 22 domain chips present in both languages with correct counts including Electrical 4, Confined Space 1, Environmental 3, Heat/Fatigue/MH 6. Severity zero DOM exposure. Mobile 414 no overflow. Wellness tone audit (source-reviewed): operational/judgment-degradation voice confirmed in all 6 topics — fatigue has 'drive home is the #1 way you die' framing, mental_health has direct-question framing 'Are you OK? Are you thinking about hurting yourself?' + 988 + EAP, drug_alcohol uses non-stereotype impairment patterns (Rx painkiller, prior-night marijuana, energy drink + pre-workout), heat/cold_stress emphasize judgment loss not poster fluff, bloodborne has 'gloves first, then help' muscle-memory framing.
critical_code_review_comments: wellness.js 102 lines, wellness.es.js 73 lines, electrical.js/electrical.es.js, confined_space.*, environmental.* all well under the 700-line limit.
Severity remains EN-JS-only (53 EN values, 0 ES values, 0 DOM exposure of 'fatal_risk'/'serious_injury'/'severity' in any visible text or testid).

Wellness operational tone is strong and consistent — explicitly rejects corporate-wellness drift. fatigue.js: 'The single most likely way a MASCI worker dies from this job isn't on a paver... It's the drive home.' mental_health.js: 'The fix is not posters. It's foremen and crew leads who know the signs, ask the direct question.' drug_alcohol.js: avoids stereotype, names prescription painkillers, prior-night marijuana, energy-drink stacking. heat_stress.js: 'Heat doesn't kill workers directly... it kills them through degraded judgment.' bloodborne.js: 'gloves first, then help' muscle-memory framing. ES translations preserve the same field-leader register (e.g., fatigue.es: 'La forma más probable en que un trabajador de MASCI muere por este trabajo no es en una pavimentadora... Es el viaje a casa').

Batch 4 severity distribution matches problem statement: Electrical 3 fatal_risk (electrical_safety, loto, generator_temp_power) + 1 serious_injury (light_tower); Confined Space 1 fatal_risk; Environmental 1 fatal_risk (lightning) + 2 serious_injury (wildlife_insects, spill_response); Wellness 3 fatal_risk (fatigue, drug_alcohol, mental_health) + 3 serious_injury (heat_stress, cold_stress, bloodborne).
